summary: The imported description does not match the original fix. ArrayVec::insert accepted indices greater than len but below capacity, causing len - index to underflow during element shifting instead of returning Some(element) unchanged. The fix rejects indices beyond len or equal to capacity. The fix-added test_insert_out_of_bounds in tests/tests.rs inserts at index 1 into an empty vector with capacity 8 and expects rejection. This is a proposed reversal; no tests were run.
